property_summary: After any call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply must not increase.
After burn(uint256) reduces the caller's balance by _value, totalSupply must also decrease by the same _value.
For any valid burn call, the final totalSupply equals the initial totalSupply minus the burn amount.
For any burn call, the totalSupply after the call equals the totalSupply before the call minus the value burnt.
After a burn reduces the caller's balance, totalSupply must be strictly less than the caller's balance before the burn plus the initial totalSupply.
After a successful burn, the totalSupply must decrease by exactly the burned amount.
After a call to burn(value), the totalSupply is never increased.
After a burn call that does not revert, totalSupply must be strictly less than before the burn.
After any burn(value) call, totalSupply <= previous totalSupply.
For any owner, after burn(value), totalSupply must be less than or equal to totalSupply before the call minus value
After any sequence of calls ending with burn(uint256), totalSupply is never less than its initial value.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply never increases.
The totalSupply after burn() is exactly the sum of all balances.
After any call to burn(uint256), totalSupply decreased by exactly the value returned by burn().
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply does not increase.
After calling burn(uint256), totalSupply must decrease by exactly the burned amount.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply must be less than its value before the call.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply must change.
After calling burn(uint256), the sum of balances (balanceOf[owner] + balanceOf[others]) equals the totalSupply.
After a call to burn, totalSupply equals the sum of all balances.
After burn, totalSupply equals initial totalSupply minus _value (not minus twice _value).
After calling burn(x) on an account with sufficient balance, totalSupply decreases by exactly x.
After a successful burn(_value), the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
After burn(_value), the total supply decreases by exactly the account balance decrease for that account.
After a successful burn, the totalSupply decreases by exactly the burned value, not twice the burned value.
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn(_value), the sum of totalSupply and balanceOf[owner] remains constant (equal to its initial value).
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn(_value), the total supply never increases above the initial total supply.
After a call to burn(uint256), the totalSupply never increases compared to its pre-burn value.
The totalSupply after a burn operation is always equal to the initial totalSupply minus the sum of all burn amounts.
After a call to burn, the totalSupply never increases compared to its pre-burn value.
After burning, totalSupply is invariant under mintToken for any burn value
After burning, totalSupply plus balanceOf[msg.sender] is constant for any burn value and any prior mint.
After burning, totalSupply is always equal to the sum of all balances (balanceOf[owner] + balanceOf[others]) for any initial mint and burn amount.
After a successful burn of _value, totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
After any burn, the sum of totalSupply and the balance of the burner equals the sum of totalSupply and balanceOf[burner] before the burn plus the amount minted since then.
burn(uint256) only succeeds (does not revert) when called by the owner, and reverts for non-owner callers.
After any call to burn(uint256), totalSupply can only decrease or stay the same, never increase.
After any call to burn(uint256), totalSupply is always decreased by exactly the amount burned, regardless of who calls it.
Only the owner can decrease totalSupply via burn(uint256); a non-owner caller must not change totalSupply.
If a non-owner calls burn(0), the call must revert.
After calling burn(uint256), the balanceOf of the caller decreases by exactly _value.
After calling burn(uint256), the totalSupply decreases by exactly _value.
After any non-reverting burn call, the caller's balanceOf decreases by exactly _value.
After a successful burn call, the sum of balanceOf[caller] and totalSupply remains unchanged from before the call.
After any non-reverting burn call, the sum of balanceOf[any_address] and totalSupply either remains unchanged or decreases by _value for the caller
After a burn, the totalSupply decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After a burn, the totalSupply plus the caller's balance equals the sum that would be expected before the burn plus the burned amount.
After a burn, the sum of totalSupply and burn amount remains unchanged only if totalSupply is decremented.
After any sequence ending with a burn, the totalSupply plus the caller's balance equals the initial totalSupply plus the caller's initial balance minus the burn amount.
After a burn of a given value, the sum of totalSupply and the caller's balance remains unchanged from before the burn.
After burning tokens, the caller's balance of the contract's owner never becomes negative.
After burning tokens, the contract's totalSupply is always at least the sum of all balances held by the owner and any other account that had a balance before the burn.
After burning tokens, the owner's balance never decreases relative to totalSupply minus the sum of all observed balances.
After burning tokens, the total supply never increases.
After a burn, the caller's balance plus the total supply never exceeds its previous value plus the value burned.
After a call to burn, the caller's balance of the reference contract never increases.
After a call to burn, the total supply change equals the balance decrease of the caller.
After burn, the total supply equals the sum of all balances.
The sum of all balances (totalSupply) should not increase after a call to burn.
After calling burn, the balance of any account other than the caller does not increase.
After burn() reverts, no account's frozen state changes.
After calling burn(address(this)), the frozenAccount state of any address remains unchanged.
After a call to burn() that reverts, the frozenAccount mapping remains unchanged for an arbitrary address k.
After any call to burn(), the frozenAccount status of the caller is unchanged.
After calling burn(), the frozenAccount status of the contract owner remains unchanged.
The burn function never reverts when called by the owner with a valid amount.
The burn function never reverts when called by the owner with a valid balance.
After calling burn with any valid owner and amount, the owned() function does not revert.
Calling burn as the owner never reverts regardless of the burn amount.
After any call to burn(uint256) by the owner with any balance, the state variable 'owner' remains unchanged.
After a burn, the transfer function always returns true (i.e., never returns false).
transfer returns true when called from any address that does not revert
For all addresses and amounts, calling transfer from any address after a burn (via the original msg.sender) returns the same boolean value as the original call did.
After invoking burn with the owner's address, the transfer function always returns true when called on the owner's balance.
For any sender and recipient that are not frozen, the transfer function must return true when the sender has sufficient balance.
After a successful call to transfer, the return value is always true.
The return value of transfer is always true when it does not revert.
The return value of the last successful transfer is stored as true in the return value of burn when called by the owner after a successful transfer.
The burn function always returns true when it succeeds.
The return value of burn matches the success of the call (non-revert).
The return value of burn(mintedAmount) for the owner equals the negation of the caller being frozen.
After a successful burn, the owner's balance and totalSupply decrease by exactly the burned amount.
The return value of burn when called by the owner and not reverting is always true.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn(uint256), the owner's balance before the burn is at least the burn amount, ensuring no underflow.
After any sequence of calls, including burn, the totalSupply is always at least the sum of all balances.
The burn function must never increase the totalSupply.
After a burn, the caller's balance does not become negative (i.e., balanceOf[msg.sender] does not underflow).
The totalSupply is always equal to the sum of all balances (the invariant from the ERC20 standard) after any sequence of calls ending with burn.
After any number of burn calls, totalSupply is always equal to the initial totalSupply minus the sum of all burned amounts (i.e., it never increases).
After any call to burn, totalSupply does not increase.
The totalSupply must not decrease when mintToken is called by the owner.
After a burn, the sum of balanceOf across all addresses plus totalSupply is unchanged.
After a burn, the caller's balance plus totalSupply must be at least the pre-burn totalSupply.
After a burn, the owner's balance of minted tokens is non-negative.
After a burn, the caller's balanceOf plus totalSupply is invariant modulo the burn amount.
